tau_branch.rule: the supervisor's calibrated branch (the escalation ruling on the committed calibration receipts): tau_cal = the trained fixed machine's own per-layer smoothed-PR ceiling at the locked horizon, measured on the post-cooldown (PRIMARY-scored) trained state
tau_branch.semantics: growth fires exactly when a boundary is MORE saturated than anything the fixed machine exhibits
tau_branch.hazard: the K8 idle-store hazard stated verbatim: PR ~20 of 128 is the fixed machine's own regime ceiling, NOT absolute capacity; the growth arm tests growth-past-the-exhibited-regime, not growth at capacity.  The registered-96 informative-null branch's verdict is delivered by the reachability receipts themselves (PR max ~25 vs 96 at both horizons) and is receipted permanently there
tau_branch.event_receipts: every firing event receipts its PR value, the per-head PR at the fire boundary, the window position (boundary), the post-event first-boundary per-head PR, and the mean PR drop at the event

regime_lock.horizon_rule: 8192 LOCKED per the ruling (the shortest scanned horizon; same reachability verdict; the emender fold arithmetic is decisive: 4x deeper, not 8x)

protocol.stream: the registered flagship stream's documents, full 8192-byte windows from eligible documents only (byte_length >= 8193), document-bounded, split-disjoint
protocol.optimizer: plain AdamW at the registered gdn2 nomination's transferred settings, all four arms (the K6/K8/side-by-side convention; identical numbers on both machines)

predictions.P_G1: the fixed GDN2 arm's state saturates in-regime: the smoothed mean per-head participation ratio reaches tau_sat=96 on the trained fixed machine (receipted by the calibration scan itself)
predictions.P_G2: gdn2_growth beats gdn2_fixed by MORE than 0.075 nats/byte on the post-cooldown PRIMARY score AND the tau_sat trigger fired in-regime; a tie within the band, or a never-fired trigger, is the declared informative null (the K8 tie branch), reported as such
predictions.P_G3: emender_growable beats gdn2_growth by MORE than 0.075 nats/byte post-cooldown at matched exposure (state sizes and parameter deltas first-class); gdn2_growth >= emender_growable within the band refutes the slot story's necessity at this scale
predictions.fixed_8: the born-at-8 size control: separates grown-large from born-large; no directional prediction pre-stated (the registration states none for the control)
predictions.tau_note: P-G2's 'trigger fired in-regime' clause reads at the CALIBRATED tau (the registered 96's informative-null verdict is the reachability receipt); P-G3's adjudication is PENDING the emender arm's landing (the ~36h matched-exposure long pole, detached per the ruling)
